filo_ambulance.description: - Fix players killed by a long fall going down in mid-air. They now land first, then go into knockout, last stand or death

filo_appearance.description:
- Fix other players not seeing your hair fade when a tattoo script redraws tattoos on remote players (0r-tattoo_designer does)
- Fix hair fades stacking up while browsing them in the barber
- Fix tattoo scripts using the illenium-appearance provider not re-applying their tattoos after the menu closes

filo_bolt.description:
- Add real tools on the nuts: impact gun (hold left click), torque wrench with a ratchet and tire iron (grab a nut and circle the mouse), set with `Config.Tools` and the export's new `tool` option
- Add a streamed `filo_tireiron` prop
- Add nut resistance: seized nuts are hard to crack loose and tightening nuts get stiff as they seat (`resistance` per tool)
- Change tool sounds to play through NUI with `Config.Volume`, replacing the audio bank
- Fix nuts spawning inside the wheel on vehicles with mirrored wheel bones
- Remove `Config.OneAtATime` and the debug test target

filo_chat.description:
- Rework the UI in the Filo liquid chrome look: graphite surfaces, silver chrome buttons and highlights, upright sentence-case text, no glows, gradients or scanlines
- Change the default `accent` and `background` to the liquid chrome colours (`#D9DBE0` / `#141415`). Set your own colours in the branding config to keep your look

filo_consumables.description:
- Add presets for the animation dictionary and clip fields in the creator (`Config.Suggestions.anims`), with clips filtered to the chosen dictionary
- Fix the creator's preset dropdowns (screen effect, timecycle, camera shake, models, scenarios, items, images, walk style) not opening in-game

filo_discordgate.description: - Change screen titles to uppercase in Barlow Semi Condensed Bold (upright), for example `FOB PROGRAMMER` and `LAST STAND`. Buttons, tabs and labels stay in sentence case

filo_doj.description:
- Add evidence boards placed in `/dojcreator`, as a floating screen or a TV prop, where players with the point's jobs draw and pin images and videos (`Config.Boards`)
- Add rotation, tilt and height controls with a live preview when placing a board
- Add `Config.MicEffect` to tune or turn off the PA speaker sound in microphone zones
- Change the creator to load faster with a minified UI

filo_drugscreator.description:
- Add `Min. police on duty` to harvest fields, processing zones and labs: harvesting, processing and entering the lab are refused until that many police are on duty (0 = no requirement)
- Add `Jobs counted as police` to Settings (`policeJobs` in `Config.DefaultSettings`, default `police`). On Qbox and QBCore only on-duty players count; on ESX the job is enough

filo_fastfood.description:
- Add `/fastfoodprices` for business bosses to set their own menu prices, saved per location and kept when admins edit the location
- Add **Owner min price** and **Owner max price** to menu items in the creator (`minPrice` / `maxPrice` in config) to limit what owners can charge
- Add `Config.OwnerPricing` to turn owner pricing off, rename the command, let a job grade change prices instead of only bosses, and set the default price range (50% to 200% of the base price)
- Add `Config.UseFiloConsumables` so locations wait for filo_consumables items to load instead of reporting them missing at startup
- Change the UI to a minified build, which loads faster

filo_firefighter.description:
- Add responsible departments per fire location in `/firecreator`: only those departments get the dispatch and blips, and automatic fires only start there while enough of them are on duty (`Config.autoFires.minOnDuty`)
- Change the creator and HUD to load faster with a minified UI

filo_jack.description:
- Add an extension screw that winds out of the ram on tall and lifted vehicles, so the jack always reaches the body
- Fix the jack standing outside the body on some vehicles; it now goes under the sill between the wheels
- Fix the ram stopping short of the underbody on lifted vehicles

filo_joblib.description:
- Add QBCore and ESX support next to Qbox. The framework is picked automatically, and the framework code is in the editable `bridge/` folder
- Fix carries and escorts staying attached when either player logs out to the character menu or the other player disappears

filo_keybinds.description: - Change `/keybinds` to a server command with help text in chat suggestions

filo_loadingscreen.description:
- Change the screen to a minified build and drop the background blur for better performance
- Fix the top of the loading percentage and title being cut off

filo_muffler.description: - Refactor vehicle state management and update version checker

filo_police.description:
- Rework the creator's interface in Svelte, built and minified with Vite
- Remove the background blur behind the creator, which cost frames

filo_radialmenu.description: - Fix the top of the highlighted option's icon being cut off

filo_radio.description:
- Add a `Handheld at mouth` talk animation
- Add per-animation prop placement: `prop` in `Config.Animations` can be a table with `offset`, `rotation` and `bone`
- Rework the radio look into a realistic duty handheld with an amber backlit screen, speaker grille and rubber keys
- Change the radio's top plate to show `Config.Branding.name`
- Change the transmit-off sound to a cleaner double beep
- Remove the `Handheld (VS Radio)` animation

filo_radiostation.description:
- Rework the radio tuner and the studio into a new UI, replacing the context menus
- Add host mix sliders for music and soundboard volume, heard by everyone on the station
- Change open panels to update live when the station, callers or music change

filo_rewards.description:
- Add QBCore and ESX support next to Qbox. `Config.Framework = 'auto'` picks the started framework, or set `'qbx'`, `'qb'` or `'esx'`
- Add vehicle rewards on QBCore (`player_vehicles`, in `Config.VehicleGarage`) and ESX (`owned_vehicles`)
- Change Tebex vehicle packages on ESX to match esx_vehicleshop's `vehicles` table, or the spawn model when that table doesn't exist
- Remove the hard `qbx_core` dependency

filo_robberycreator.description:
- Fix the pause map cursor snapping to every blip, so waypoints could only be set on blips, when a robbery's location was saved with whole-number coordinates
- Fix props, vault doors, stand spots and police alert blips being misplaced for robberies with whole-number coordinates

filo_slashtire.description:
- Add qb-target support
- Add translatable labels under `locales/`
- Change slashing to be checked by the server (distance and held weapon)
- Fix only the last slashed tire syncing to players who join later or drive up to the vehicle
- Fix players getting stuck in place while turning towards the tire
- Fix players staying marked as busy if the slash was interrupted

filo_stealwheels.description:
- **Breaking:** `Config.RequiredItem` and `Config.DecreaseDurability` are replaced by `Config.Tools`, a list of tool items with their own durability loss. Add the new `impact_gun` and `torque_wrench` items to ox_inventory
- **Breaking:** Requires filo_bolt 1.1.0 or newer
- Add the impact gun and torque wrench as tools, each shown in filo_bolt's minigame
- Change the inventory to go through the built-in bridge, so `ox_inventory` is no longer required
- Fix rear wheels on 4-wheeled cars not coming off or going back on correctly
- Fix stolen and attached wheels taking a moment to show for other players
- Fix tools not wearing down outside ox_inventory (ESX's default inventory still has no durability)

filo_tv.description: - Fix FXServer crashing when a player seeks or leaves while a YouTube video is streaming, by serving videos in 2 MB ranges

filo_ui.description:
- Add the player's mugshot to the quick menu header
- Add profile artwork to the quick menu player card: PNGs in `web/profile/`, per job or a default (`Config.QuickMenu.profileArt`)
- Change the Keybinds tile to grey out when `filo_keybinds` isn't running, and to open it through its `open` export
- Change the NUI to a Svelte build (no change in look or behaviour)
- Remove the blur behind the HUD panels and the HUD editor

filo_vehiclekeys.description:
- Add taking the key off a dead NPC driver: trying to enter their car unlocks it and gives you the key (`Config.Carjack.DeadDriverKeys`)
- Fix cars handed over by a carjack starting without the key in the ignition
Every fix or patch bumps the version in `fxmanifest.lua` and gets an entry here.
